sn10.2:1.1: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Rājagaha on Mount Vulture Peak.
sn10.2:1.2: Then the yakkha Sakkanāmaka approached the Blessed One and addressed him in verse:
sn10.2:2.3: It isn’t good for you, an ascetic,
sn10.2:3.3: The wise man ought not to stir his mind
sn10.2:3.4: With compassion towards such a person.
